paragraphs.text: This is now, beloved, the second epistle that I write unto you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by putting you in remembrance;
paragraphs.original: Ταύτην ἤδη, ἀγαπητοί, δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν, ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν,
paragraphs.translit: Tautēn ēdē, agapētoi, deuteran hymin graphō epistolēn, en hais diegeirō hymōn en hypomnēsei tēn eilikrinē dianoian,

paragraphs.text: that ye should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandments of the Lord and Saviour through your apostles:
paragraphs.original: μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος,
paragraphs.translit: mnēsthēnai tōn proeirēmenōn rhēmatōn hypo tōn hagiōn prophētōn kai tēs tōn apostolōn hymōn entolēs tou kyriou kai sōtēros,

paragraphs.text: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers shall come with mockery, walking after their own lusts,
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι
paragraphs.translit: touto prōton ginōskontes hoti eleusontai epʼ eschatōn tōn hēmerōn en empaigmonē empaiktai kata tas idias epithymias autōn poreuomenoi

paragraphs.text: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ; ἀφʼ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν, πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως.
paragraphs.translit: kai legontes· Pou estin hē epangelia tēs parousias autou; aphʼ hēs gar hoi pateres ekoimēthēsan, panta houtōs diamenei apʼ archēs ktiseōs.

paragraphs.text: For this they willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth compacted out of water and amidst water, by the word of God;
paragraphs.original: λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ διʼ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγῳ,
paragraphs.translit: lanthanei gar autous touto thelontas hoti ouranoi ēsan ekpalai kai gē ex hydatos kai diʼ hydatos synestōsa tō tou theou logō,

paragraphs.text: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
paragraphs.original: διʼ ὧν ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο·
paragraphs.translit: diʼ hōn ho tote kosmos hydati kataklystheis apōleto·

paragraphs.text: but the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de nyn ouranoi kai hē gē tō autō logō tethēsaurismenoi eisin pyri tēroumenoi eis hēmeran kriseōs kai apōleias tōn asebōn anthrōpōn.

paragraphs.text: But forget not this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
paragraphs.original: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς, ἀγαπητοί, ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία.
paragraphs.translit: Hen de touto mē lanthanetō hymas, agapētoi, hoti mia hēmera para kyriō hōs chilia etē kai chilia etē hōs hēmera mia.

paragraphs.text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some count slackness; but is longsuffering to you-ward, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
paragraphs.original: οὐ βραδύνει κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται, ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ὑμᾶς, μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι.
paragraphs.translit: ou bradynei kyrios tēs epangelias, hōs tines bradytēta hēgountai, alla makrothymei eis hymas, mē boulomenos tinas apolesthai alla pantas eis metanoian chōrēsai.

paragraphs.text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
paragraphs.original: ἥξει δὲ ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης, ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται, στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα λυθήσεται, καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται.
paragraphs.translit: hēxei de hēmera kyriou hōs kleptēs, en hē hoi ouranoi rhoizēdon pareleusontai, stoicheia de kausoumena lythēsetai, kai gē kai ta en autē erga heurethēsetai.

paragraphs.text: Seeing that these things are thus all to be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in [all] holy living and godliness,
paragraphs.original: Τούτων οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις,
paragraphs.translit: Toutōn houtōs pantōn lyomenōn potapous dei hyparchein hymas en hagiais anastrophais kai eusebeiais,

paragraphs.text: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, by reason of which the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
paragraphs.original: προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέρας, διʼ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται·
paragraphs.translit: prosdokōntas kai speudontas tēn parousian tēs tou theou hēmeras, diʼ hēn ouranoi pyroumenoi lythēsontai kai stoicheia kausoumena tēketai·

paragraphs.text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
paragraphs.original: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν, ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: kainous de ouranous kai gēn kainēn kata to epangelma autou prosdokōmen, en hois dikaiosynē katoikei.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for these things, give diligence that ye may be found in peace, without spot and blameless in his sight.
paragraphs.original: Διό, ἀγαπητοί, ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ,
paragraphs.translit: Dio, agapētoi, tauta prosdokōntes spoudasate aspiloi kai amōmētoi autō heurethēnai en eirēnē,

paragraphs.text: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote unto you;
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν,
paragraphs.translit: kai tēn tou kyriou hēmōn makrothymian sōtērian hēgeisthe, kathōs kai ho agapētos hēmōn adelphos Paulos kata tēn dotheisan autō sophian egrapsen hymin,

paragraphs.text: as also in all [his] epistles, speaking in them of these things; wherein are some things hard to be understood, which the ignorant and unstedfast wrest, as [they do] also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
paragraphs.original: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν.
paragraphs.translit: hōs kai en pasais tais epistolais lalōn en autais peri toutōn, en hais estin dysnoēta tina, ha hoi amatheis kai astēriktoi streblousin hōs kai tas loipas graphas pros tēn idian autōn apōleian.

paragraphs.text: Ye therefore, beloved, knowing [these things] beforehand, beware lest, being carried away with the error of the wicked, ye fall from your own stedfastness.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς οὖν, ἀγαπητοί, προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hymeis oun, agapētoi, proginōskontes phylassesthe hina mē tē tōn athesmōn planē synapachthentes ekpesēte tou idiou stērigmou,

paragraphs.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him [be] the glory both now and for ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος. ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: auxanete de en chariti kai gnōsei tou kyriou hēmōn kai sōtēros Iēsou Christou. autō hē doxa kai nyn kai eis hēmeran aiōnos. amēn.
